segments.he: בָּא לוֹ בַּאֲרוּכָּה חַיָּיב, בִּקְצָרָה פָּטוּר וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רָבָא: קְצָרָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ – אֲפִילּוּ עָקֵב בְּצַד גּוּדָל, וַאֲפִילּוּ כׇּל הַיּוֹם כּוּלּוֹ.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If, at the time that one was unaware either that he was impure, or that he was in the Temple, «he went out» by way of «a longer» route when he could have taken a shorter route, he is «liable» to bring a sliding-scale offering. But if he left the Temple via «the shortest» way, he is «exempt. Rava says:» With regard to the «short» route, «which» the Sages «said» here that he is exempt for, this does not necessarily mean that he left the Temple as quickly as possible, as if he took the most direct route he is exempt «even» if he walked with exceedingly small steps, «heel to toe, and even» if it took him «all day long.»
